Definition.description: A single node in a .bnto.json recipe. Can contain child nodes (recursive).

id.description: Unique identifier for this node within the recipe.

inputPorts.description: Input connection ports for this node.

nodes.description: Child nodes (for container nodes like group, loop, parallel). Recursive.

outputPorts.description: Output connection ports for this node.

parameters.description: Configuration parameters for this node (key-value pairs).

parentId.description: Optional: the id of the parent node (for nested nodes inside groups/loops).

position.description: The node's position on the visual editor canvas.

version.description: The format version of this definition (semver, e.g., '1.0.0').

Edge.description: A connection between two nodes in the pipeline graph.

source.description: The id of the source node (where data flows FROM).

sourceHandle.description: Optional: which output port on the source node.

target.description: The id of the target node (where data flows TO).

targetHandle.description: Optional: which input port on the target node.

keepOnlySet.description: If true, only fields listed in `values` are kept in the output.

values.description: Map of field names to their values.

Metadata.description: Descriptive metadata about the node (description, timestamps, tags).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this node was created.

customData.description: Open-ended key-value pairs for consumer-specific data.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this node does.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification.

Port.description: A connection point on a node (input or output).

handle.description: Optional handle identifier used by the visual editor for positioning.

id.description: Unique identifier for this port within its node.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the port.

definitionSchema.description: A .bnto.json recipe definition. Describes a pipeline of nodes that process data.
definitionSchema.title: Bnto Definition
